title: Lorwyn Eclipsed | Episode 3: Aweary of This Moon

entities.name: Dina
entities.description: A Strixhaven teaching assistant who leads Liliana and Ajani to the Harrier's Wood after losing four students.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer and planeswalker, professor at Strixhaven, who senses that the students are not dead.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who tracks the students to Lorwyn by a flower petal and leaves to fetch them via Shandalar.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Liliana compares the missing students to, as someone who is not dead.

entities.name: Abigale
entities.description: An owlin student who signs and carries her friends across the Wanderwine by flying.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: A vampire student with an interest in environments who is captured by Lluwen in the Gilt-Leaf Wood.

entities.name: Sanar
entities.description: A goblin student who wants to go home and finish his term project.

entities.name: Tamira
entities.description: A gorgon student from Shandalar who speaks for the group and leads the way east.

entities.name: Killian
entities.description: Someone connected to Abigale who Dina expects to be furious that she lost her.

entities.name: Brigid Baeli
entities.description: A kithkin hero, a close friend of Queen Maralen with a half-severed link to the thoughtweft, who leads the students to Goldmeadow and is turned to the Shadowmoor side.

entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: A hoofed elf hunter in green and brown who captures Kirol and says he is a poor hunter.

entities.name: Morcant
entities.description: The elf leader to whom Lluwen intends to bring Kirol.

entities.name: Maralen
entities.description: Queen of the faeries of both Lorwyn and Shadowmoor, who lives in Glen Elendra.

entities.name: Isilu
entities.description: The moon-headed incarnation, walking across the meadow and bringing night to Goldmeadow.

entities.name: Blue faerie
entities.description: The faerie that led the students through the Omenpath and laughs at them in the meeting hall before the alarm bells ring.

entities.name: Goldmeadow
entities.description: A walled kithkin village with a central watchtower that Shadowmoor overtakes.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: The daylit side of the plane.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: The night side of the plane, which suddenly descends on Goldmeadow.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: Tamira's home plane, linked to Lorwyn by a stable Omenpath.

entities.name: Glen Elendra
entities.description: Maralen's hidden home that is meant to be impossible for outsiders to find.

entities.name: Wanderwine
entities.description: The widest river the students have seen, which they cross by air.

entities.name: Gilt-Leaf Wood
entities.description: A great wood with boughs woven like baskets where Lluwen captures Kirol.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: Portals between planes; one unseen near Harrier's Wood links to Lorwyn.

entities.name: Thoughtweft
entities.description: The kithkin mental web, which Brigid's mangled connection to makes locals nervous.

entities.name: Harrier's Wood
entities.description: The forest near Strixhaven where the students vanished.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders whose spiral symbol Kirol and Sanar associate with the landscape's patterns.

events.summary: Dina leads Liliana and Ajani to the Harrier's Wood to search for the four missing students.
events.quote: led the two out of the building where Liliana's office was located and across the fields toward the Harrier's Wood.

events.summary: Liliana calls up black fog and concludes the students are not dead.
Ajani finds a blue stitched flower petal and recognizes it as coming from a plane where denizens tailor with flowers, which Liliana identifies as Lorwyn.
Ajani refuses to take Liliana along and plans to reach the students through a stable Omenpath between Lorwyn and Shandalar.
events.quote: I can't take you with me.

events.summary: Ajani glows and vanishes to go after the students, and Liliana takes Dina back to campus.
events.quote: On the second step, he was gone.

events.summary: Brigid leads the students toward Goldmeadow, saying not just anyone could get them there.
events.quote: But not just anyone could get you to Goldmeadow

events.summary: The students arrive at Goldmeadow and Brigid takes them into the meeting hall, saying her mangled thoughtweft connection makes the locals nervous.
events.quote: I make the locals a bit nervous, what with my connection to the thoughtweft all mangled up and half-severed.

events.summary: The students explain how they arrived; Brigid identifies the creature as a faerie and says she is a close friend of Queen Maralen.
events.quote: I'm sort of a close friend of their queen.

events.summary: The blue faerie reappears in the meeting hall and laughs until alarm bells drown it out, then flies away.
events.quote: the little blue faerie from before, which had flown in through a window and was now hovering in front of him.

events.summary: Isilu walks past Goldmeadow and the darkness transforms the village into its Shadowmoor aspect.
events.quote: Everywhere the darkness touched, the city was transformed.

events.summary: Brigid tells the students to flee and explains how to reach Glen Elendra, warning them not to listen to anyone who begs them to turn around.
events.quote: When I step through this door, you run, you understand me?

events.summary: The students flee through a village torn between day and night as the shadows swallow the sunlit defenders.
events.quote: bit by bit, the archers were falling, transforming into moon-eyed fighters from the other side.

events.summary: Night-side figures pull Brigid into the darkness, transforming her, and she fights alongside them against her former allies.
events.quote: when she opened her eyes again, they were full moon-bright, filled with a light that had nothing to do with the day.

events.summary: The students escape Goldmeadow and reason that the night side is frightened, not evil.
events.quote: I don't think the night is bad here, just different

events.summary: Abigale flies Sanar, Kirol and Tam across the Wanderwine one at a time.
events.quote: They spread their arms, and Abigale grasped them, taking to the air.

events.summary: The group reaches the Gilt-Leaf Wood, where Kirol lags behind and is seized by a silent hunter.
events.quote: a silent hunter rose out of the bushes behind Kirol and grabbed them, pulling them out of sight before they could make a sound.

events.summary: Lluwen holds a knife to Kirol and demands to know what they know about why Isilu walks.
events.quote: I know you know why Isilu walks. I want to know what you know.

events.summary: Lluwen takes Kirol prisoner to bring before High Perfect Morcant, and leads them deeper into the forest.
events.quote: High Perfect Morcant will want to see you.

relations.note: Once-close acquaintances, no longer old friends, who work together to find the students.
relations.quote: My, you've learned sarcasm in our time apart, kitty-cat.

relations.note: Brigid says she is a close friend of the queen.
relations.quote: I'm sort of a close friend of their queen.

relations.note: Maralen is queen of the faeries of both Lorwyn and Shadowmoor.
relations.quote: she's queen of the faeries of both Lorwyn and Shadowmoor

relations.note: Lluwen takes his prisoner to High Perfect Morcant.
relations.quote: High Perfect Morcant will want to see you.
You're my prisoner now, and that means you have to do as I say.

relations.note: Isilu's darkness transforms Brigid's village and turns her to the night side.
relations.quote: In the meadow outside the city walls, Isilu was walking.
